thread:
maria (Docs): Heads-up: the Console observability quickstart is missing a Kotlin embed showing TraceHook + KV prefetch usage, and one of the links in the 'Cost & latency breakdown' section 404s after the storage path change. Can someone help patch the quickstart, add a tiny Kotlin snippet, and update the dashboard screenshot/legend? cc @ashley @jon :wave:

ashley (SDK): On it — can you paste the exact pattern you want? we already have Java/Python examples in the repo, just no Kotlin small example yet.

maria (Docs): Minimal is fine. Example should show attaching trace + a simple kv-prefetch tag so users can map traces to cost metrics. Something like:
```kotlin
val tracer = RedwoodTrace.init(config)
tracer.start("kv_prefetch").setTag("kv_hits", 1)
```
Just 2-3 lines and a comment about metric mapping.

jon (Eng): FYI metric key was renamed in infra last week from `console.kv.prefetch` -> `console.kv.prefetch_v2`. Screenshot in the quickstart still references the old metric which explains part of the confusion. I'll open an infra ticket to fix redirects for the docs link.

sam (Platform): If we switch to v2 please add a one-liner compatibility note for older Dedicated installs. I can draft a tiny fallback snippet that checks `prefetch_v2` and falls back to `prefetch`.

maria (Docs): Good call. Also the dashboard legend header currently says `latency_ms` but our panels were standardized to `p50_latency_ms`/`p95_latency_ms`. Need to update alt text for screenshots too.

ashley (SDK): Drafting PR in docs repo. Will add Kotlin example + footnote about metric rename and a short block about p50/p95 naming. Ping @pavel for style review.

pavel (Infra): Happy to review. Small stylistic nit: prefer `Trace.start("...")` API in examples (we just adjusted names) and prefer explicit epoch millis for timestamps in sample code. I can paste the corrected snippet if you want.

ashley (SDK): Yes please paste your version. I'll replace before PR.

pavel (Infra): Suggested snippet:
```kotlin
val tracer = Trace.init(config)
val span = tracer.start("kv_prefetch")
span.setTag("kv_hits", 1L) // use long for counts
span.finish()
```
Add a note: "On older servers, metric key may be `console.kv.prefetch`; check migration guide."

maria (Docs): Perfect. One more: the broken URL is /docs/console/observability/costs#kv-prefetch — redirect missing. jon, can you follow up infra side?

jon (Eng): Yep. I've created a redirect request with infra ticket INF-4123 and left a comment for docs-team. Also will expose a short mapping table in the migration guide listing old->new metric keys.

ashley (SDK): PR created as draft: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/10001 — includes Kotlin snippet, p50/p95 note, and placeholder for new screenshot. Left TODO for image capture.

docs-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/pr-10001 (preview page builds but screenshot missing)

sam (Platform): I'll capture the updated dashboard screenshot this afternoon (use the `observability/dev-preview` account). Will upload to the PR and update alt text with `p50/p95` mapping.

maria (Docs): Thanks. After screenshot and pavel's code tweak, we can request reviewers. @ashley mark @jon and @pavel as reviewers and put `Docs: quickstart-obsv` label.

ashley (SDK): Done — added reviewers and label. Also added an `<!-- redirect: /docs/console/old-cost -> /docs/console/observability/costs -->` temporary comment in the markdown to help until infra redirect lands.

pavel (Infra): Quick reminder: include a one-liner for nginx redirect for on-prem customers in the migration guide:
```nginx
rewrite ^/docs/console/old-cost$ /docs/console/observability/costs permanent;
```

maria (Docs): Added note in PR description. Thanks!

jon (Eng): INF-4123 now has a `in-progress` tag. I'll update the redirect once infra toggles go through.

sam (Platform): Uploaded screenshot to PR and updated image alt text to mention `p50_latency_ms` and `p95_latency_ms`.

ashley (SDK): Updated PR with pavel's snippet and fixed formatting. Ready for review.

pavel (Infra): Reviewed and left one tiny wording nit (prefer `kv_prefetch` with underscore in code comments to match our SDK naming).

maria (Docs): Addressed nit and squashed commits. Are we good to merge?

jon (Eng): Redirect still pending but infra agreed we can merge docs change now; redirect will follow.

ashley (SDK): Merged main->docs and merged PR. PR closed. :tada:

maria (Docs): Thank you all! I'll add a short blurb in the docs changelog about Kotlin example and metric rename. If anyone sees any follow-ups file a new thread.

sam (Platform): Nice workflow.

docs-bot: Site deploy queued — build #4572.

maria (Docs): Closing this thread, will monitor deploy. :rocket:
